data.name: Angel Roulette
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to "Angel's Roulette" – a hardcore post-apocalyptic world focused on brutal survival and open-world exploration. You will find yourself in a forbidden zone where order has collapsed. The infected, hostile survivors, and brutal raiders divide this wasteland among themselves. Your goal is to survive by any means necessary and establish your own sanctuary.

Here, exploration, crafting, building, and progression are the core laws of survival. Start from scratch, scavenge for resources, upgrade your gear, develop your base, and write your own survival epic in this perilous, dynamic world.

Core Gameplay Introduction

  • Deep Open-World Exploration: Freely explore vast abandoned cities and hazardous areas. Every location may hide valuable resources or deadly threats.

  • Hardcore Survival & Base Building: Establish and upgrade your shelter. It serves as your heart for storing supplies, recovering, and planning operations. Develop it from a rudimentary camp into a fully-functional fortress, providing vital security.

  • Comprehensive Gear Customization System:

    • Weapon Upgrades & Workbench: Use scavenged parts at the workbench to deeply customize your weapons. Swap attachments, enhance performance, and forge unique tools tailored to your combat style.

  • Backpack & Crafting System: Manage limited backpack space and plan your carried supplies wisely. Collect blueprints and materials to craft various survival essentials, from medkits and ammo to traps and advanced tools.

  • Dynamic Character Progression: Gain experience through combat and survival to unlock and upgrade a personal skill tree. Enhance your specialization in combat, stealth, survival, or crafting to shape a unique survivor.

  • Multi-Faction Threats:

    • The Infected Horde: Face special infected of varying forms and abilities. They are intelligent, cooperative hunters.

    • Human Enemies: Be wary of heavily armed raider gangs who will clash violently with you over resources. You may also encounter other survivors with diverse allegiances—friend or foe is for you to decide.

  • Personalized Appearance System: Find or craft hundreds of clothing items and accessories in the wasteland. Mix and match freely to create your unique post-apocalyptic look.

Story Background

A catastrophe has swept the world, reducing civilization to ruins. Deep within the infected-ridden forbidden zone, not only do mutated monsters lurk, but also raiders who will stop at nothing for resources, and various survivor factions governing themselves. You, a lone exile who has ventured into this place, have no way back, only forward. In this wasteland, every choice you make, every item you scavenge, every fight you engage in, spins the wheel of your own survival.

Game Features Summary

  • A pure post-apocalyptic survival open-world experience.

  • Deep base construction and management system.

  • Weapon workbench modification and attachment customization.

  • Backpack management and item crafting production chains.

  • Rich character skill progression and appearance customization system.

  • Challenging factions: intelligent infected and human raiders.

Are you ready to face the ultimate test of the wasteland? Join "Angel Roulette" now and find your way to survive in this land of despair. Feel free to add the game to your wishlist and follow for future updates. Thank you for your attention and support.

data.short_description: Survival Escape Third-Person Shooter. Featuring a female protagonist, appearance customization system, body customization, backpack system, workbench & skill system, base building, and a variety of weapons with attachment modifications.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows (7/8/10) 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 750 TI
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

data.legal_notice: Users of this game are solely responsible for all consequences arising from violations of the law. This game prohibits users from pirating the game product through irregular channels. All content in this game is fictional and should not be imitated in real life. This game contains adult content. Minors are advised to play selectively under the guidance of their parents or avoid it according to the local classification system. If any physical discomfort occurs during gameplay, this game assumes no responsibility. Please stop playing immediately and consult a doctor before resuming play selectively.

content_descriptors.notes: In this game, the player can use guns to shoot enemies, can use cold weapons to attack enemies, can use explosives and set traps.  The same computer-controlled enemy will do the same thing to the player.  There are monsters in the game that attack and bite the player.  Players can practice yoga movements and fitness movements in the yoga gym, players can practice dance movements in the dance studio, players can change clothes in the changing room and customize the figure of the character.
